refnamediv.refpurpose: Fetch the SNMP object which follows the given object id

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
If object_id is a string, returns the value of the SNMP object that follows it, or &false; on error, for example when no object follows it.
If object_id is an array, returns an associative array of the values. Its keys are the object ids of the objects that were returned, as formatted by snmp_set_oid_output_format, not the ones that were passed, so two object ids followed by the same object yield a single element. An object id that no object follows is left out; &false; is returned only if no object could be read.
An E_WARNING is emitted for each object that could not be read. The form of each value depends on snmp_set_valueretrieval.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a ValueError if:
hostname contains null bytes, is 128 bytes or longer, or has a port that is not between 0 and 65535.
security_name is empty or contains null bytes.
security_level is not one of the supported levels.
auth_protocol is not supported, when security_level is authNoPriv or authPriv.
privacy_protocol is not supported, when security_level is authPriv.
object_id is an empty array.
timeout is lower than -1.
retries is lower than -1 or greater than 2147483647.
